4694-4802-7306-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4802-7306-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

728-2267-5058.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4247-4871-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4247-4871-5220-5243.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-5086-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-7452.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1651-2709-5056-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Mechanics to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Orcish Mechanics by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Mechanics.
Repeat from step 2.

1512-3755-4222.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding {U}.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

2713-7426-7628-7811.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2713-7426-7628-7811.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Zirda and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

1029-5028-7488.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Topiary Lecturer.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-7488.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

628-6798-7218.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1987-3277-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3277-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

876-2034-3169-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2048-4871-6632-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Water Crystal.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2464-3459-5078-5243.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3459-5078-5243.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

339-677-1753-3967.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

719-4508-5880-6441.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

560-2511-2835-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2511-2835-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Fecundity triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Repeat.

4321-5315-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
4321-5315-5777.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

2538-3652-3676-5187.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Guardian Project triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Guardian Project trigger, causing you to return Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4321-5226-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
4321-5226-5777.description:
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2525-2947-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni, Undying Partisan by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, its Vesperlark ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Yahenni, Undying Partisan ability.
Repeat.

437-509-549-2751-4131.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-549-2751-4131.description:
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 5.

1376-4235-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Titania and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1376-4235-4644.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's second ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Priest of Titania.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

600-1180-1543.notablePrerequisites: Nicol Bolas has at least five loyalty counters on it.
600-1180-1543.description:
Activate Nicol Bolas using Jace's third ability by removing five loyalty counters from it.
If Nicol Bolas has zero loyalty, it dies as a state-based action.
Resolve the Nicol Bolas ability, creating two token copies of Nicol Bolas that aren't legendary.
Activate a Nicol Bolas token by putting zero loyalty counter on it, putting a loyalty counters on the other Nicol Bolas token.
Repeat from step 1 using the second Nicol Bolas token.
600-1180-1543.notes: To get infinite turns, activate Jace, Cunning Castaway for an extra turn. Then, use the remaining Nicol Bolas tokens on subsequent turns.

372-2719-4753.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
372-2719-4753.description:
Cast Sakashima either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Clever Impersonator returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Sakashima.
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sakashima until Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Sakashima leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Clever Impersonator until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, Sakashima returns to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5003-5053.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mesmerizing Benthid, adding {C}{C}.
Mesmerizing Benthid dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Mesmerizing Benthid from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Mesmerizing Benthid enters the battlefield, creating two 0/2 Illusion creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Illusion, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

988-3719-3734.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have at least six cards in exile.
988-3719-3734.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Umbris and create at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrifcing Phyrexian Metamorph, returning Umbris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Umbris enters the battlefield, causing target opponent to exile cards from the top of your library until they exile a land card.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrifcing a Treasure token, returning Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Phyrexian Metamorph enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Umbris and create at least seven Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

224-1257-3478.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

712-3457.notablePrerequisites: Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
712-3457.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping itself.
Wake Thrasher triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
